claims.claim_text: Prompting language models to generate interleaved reasoning traces and task-specific actions improves multi-step decision-making and factual retrieval over reasoning-only or action-only baselines.
claims.notes: Directly supported by empirical benchmarks in the paper comparing ReAct against Chain-of-Thought (reasoning-only) and Act-only baselines.

claims.claim_text: Separating thoughts (internal mental state representation) from acts (external state transitions) provides a human-interpretable trace for diagnosing agent behavior.
claims.notes: Paper explicitly details how trajectory inspection of thought vs action steps enables error diagnosis.

claims.claim_text: SWE-bench evaluates LLM code generation on 2,294 real-world GitHub issues using existing repository unit tests and issue-reproducing fail-to-pass tests.
claims.notes: Direct factual description of the SWE-bench dataset, repos, and test harness.

claims.claim_text: Baseline language models in a zero-shot scaffold resolved fewer than 5% of SWE-bench GitHub issues (Claude 2: 4.8%, GPT-4: 1.7%).
claims.notes: Direct factual metric from SWE-bench empirical evaluation table.

claims.claim_text: Unit test suites and reproduction tests provide unambiguous universal ground-truth validation for software correctness.
claims.notes: WP-006 overstatement repaired: SWE-bench establishes executable unit tests as an automated benchmark grading mechanism, not universal semantic truth.

claims.claim_text: Toolformer self-supervises API call generation and execution, retaining only those tool calls that reduce language modeling perplexity on predicting subsequent tokens.
claims.notes: Direct factual description of the Toolformer loss filtering formula and self-supervised training algorithm.

claims.claim_text: Toolformer achieves improved zero-shot performance on math (ASDiv, SVAMP), QA (LAMA), and temporal reasoning (TempLAMA) benchmarks via API execution.
claims.notes: Direct factual metric from Toolformer benchmark tables across calculator, QA, Wikipedia, and calendar tools.

claims.claim_text: Deterministic API execution overcomes probabilistic weaknesses in arithmetic, temporal reasoning, and factual retrieval.
claims.support_location: Schick et al., 2023 combined with KAD Systems Engineering
claims.notes: Reclassified from SOURCE_FACT to DERIVED_SYNTHESIS. The deterministic vs probabilistic framing is a KAD synthesis; Toolformer frames its contribution as perplexity reduction via API calls.

claims.claim_text: Reflexion endows language agents with verbal reinforcement learning by storing natural language self-reflections derived from external environment signals (e.g. test failures, scalar rewards) in an episodic memory buffer.
claims.notes: Direct factual description of the Reflexion architecture (Actor, Evaluator, Self-Reflection, Episodic Memory).

claims.claim_text: Reflexion improves GPT-4 pass@1 accuracy on the HumanEval Python coding benchmark from 67.0% to 91.0% through iterative self-reflection on unit test feedback.
claims.notes: Direct factual metric from Reflexion code generation experiments.

claims.claim_text: Self-Refine iteratively improves text generation using self-generated multi-aspect critique without requiring external environment execution feedback, task-specific training, or human annotations.
claims.notes: Direct factual description of Self-Refine's generator-critic-refiner loop on a single frozen model.

claims.claim_text: Self-Refine achieves an average absolute performance gain of ~20% across 7 generation tasks including code optimization, acronym generation, and constrained dialogue.
claims.notes: Direct factual metric from Self-Refine experimental evaluation across tasks.

claims.claim_text: Both Reflexion and Self-Refine store verbal self-reflections derived from execution failure signals in an episodic memory buffer.
claims.notes: WP-006 conflation identified and marked UNSUPPORTED. Self-Refine does NOT use execution failure signals or episodic memory; Reflexion does.

claims.claim_text: Inference-time iterative refinement and linguistic critique can improve generation quality without gradient descent; Reflexion anchors critique on external execution signals, while Self-Refine anchors critique on internal self-evaluation.
claims.support_location: Synthesis across Shinn et al. and Madaan et al.
claims.notes: Legitimate derived synthesis explicitly identifying the commonality (training-free iterative refinement) and the key operational distinction (external feedback vs internal critique).

claims.claim_text: Reconciling probabilistic model generation with deterministic software engineering invariants is best achieved via a tripartite architecture separating probabilistic generators, deterministic harnesses, and deterministic verifiers.
claims.notes: Explicitly classified as KAD-PI Project Inference. The five papers inform this architecture but do not collectively assert it as a unified framework.
